# =============================================================================
# Configure Proxmox Backup Jobs for PBS
# =============================================================================
# Sets up scheduled backup jobs in Proxmox VE to use PBS storage.
# Replaces manual editing of /etc/pve/jobs.cfg
#
# Usage:
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml --tags verify
# =============================================================================

- name: Configure PBS backup jobs
  hosts: proxmox
  gather_facts: false

  vars:
    pbs_storage: pbs-homelab
    pbs_datastore: homelab

    # Daily backups - User data services (2 AM, keep 7 days)
    daily_containers:
      - 304  # immich
      - 303  # immich-importer
      - 501  # openwebui
      - 502  # n8n
      - 503  # obsidian-sync
      - 504  # documents

    # Weekly backups - Infrastructure services (Sunday 3 AM, keep 4 weeks)
    weekly_containers:
      - 100  # portainer
      - 101  # network-services
      - 200  # traefik
      - 201  # dashboards-app
      - 202  # authelia
      - 401  # jellyfin
      - 402  # media-management
      - 500  # monitoring-app

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Verify PBS Storage
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check PBS storage status
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: pvesm status | grep {{ pbs_storage }}
      register: pbs_status
      changed_when: false
      tags: [always]

    - name: Verify PBS is active
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: |
          PBS storage '{{ pbs_storage }}' is not active.
          Status: {{ pbs_status.stdout }}
          Fix by updating PBS password:
            pvesm set {{ pbs_storage }} --password 'YOUR_PASSWORD'
      when: "'active' not in pbs_status.stdout"
      tags: [always]

    # =========================================================================
    # Backup Pre-Backup Hook Script
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if pre-backup hook exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
      register: hook_script
      tags: [always]

    - name: Display hook script status
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Pre-backup hook: {{ 'EXISTS' if hook_script.stat.exists else 'MISSING' }}"
      tags: [verify]

    # =========================================================================
    # Configure Backup Jobs
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Create backup jobs configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/pve/jobs.cfg
        content: |
          # Proxmox Backup Jobs Configuration
          # Managed by Ansible: ansible/playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml
          # DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY - Changes will be overwritten
          #
          # Backup Strategy:
          #   - Daily: User data that changes frequently (immich, openwebui, n8n, etc.)
          #   - Weekly: Infrastructure/config that rarely changes (traefik, portainer, etc.)
          #
          # Storage: {{ pbs_storage }} (Proxmox Backup Server)
          # Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}

          # =============================================================================
          # Daily Backups - User data services (2 AM, keep 7 days)
          # =============================================================================
          # 304 = immich (photos database)
          # 303 = immich-importer (import tools)
          # 501 = openwebui (chat history, settings)
          # 502 = n8n (workflow automations)
          # 503 = obsidian-sync (notes sync server)
          # 504 = documents (paperless, stirling-pdf)
          vzdump: daily-user-data
          	enabled 1
          	schedule 02:00
          	storage {{ pbs_storage }}
          	mailnotification failure
          	mode snapshot
          	compress zstd
          	vmid {{ daily_containers | join(',') }}
          	{% if hook_script.stat.exists %}script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
          	{% endif %}prune-backups keep-daily=7

          # =============================================================================
          # Weekly Backups - Infrastructure services (Sunday 3 AM, keep 4 weeks)
          # =============================================================================
          # 100 = portainer
          # 101 = network-services (adguard)
          # 200 = traefik
          # 201 = dashboards-app
          # 202 = authelia
          # 401 = jellyfin
          # 402 = media-management
          # 500 = monitoring-app
          vzdump: weekly-infrastructure
          	enabled 1
          	schedule sun 03:00
          	storage {{ pbs_storage }}
          	mailnotification failure
          	mode snapshot
          	compress zstd
          	vmid {{ weekly_containers | join(',') }}
          	{% if hook_script.stat.exists %}script /var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh
          	{% endif %}prune-backups keep-weekly=4
        mode: '0640'
      register: jobs_config
      tags: [configure]

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Configuration
    # =========================================================================
    - name: List configured backup jobs
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: pvesh get /cluster/backup --output-format=json-pretty
      register: backup_jobs
      changed_when: false
      tags: [verify, configure]

    - name: Display backup jobs
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ backup_jobs.stdout | from_json }}"
      tags: [verify, configure]

    - name: Count daily backup containers
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        daily_count: "{{ daily_containers | length }}"
        weekly_count: "{{ weekly_containers | length }}"
      tags: [verify, configure]

    - name: Display backup summary
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "=== PBS Backup Jobs Configured ==="
          - ""
          - "Storage: {{ pbs_storage }}"
          - "Datastore: {{ pbs_datastore }}"
          - ""
          - "Daily Backups ({{ daily_count }} containers):"
          - "  Schedule: Daily at 2:00 AM"
          - "  Retention: 7 days"
          - "  Containers: {{ daily_containers | join(', ') }}"
          - ""
          - "Weekly Backups ({{ weekly_count }} containers):"
          - "  Schedule: Sunday at 3:00 AM"
          - "  Retention: 4 weeks"
          - "  Containers: {{ weekly_containers | join(', ') }}"
          - ""
          - "Excluded from backups:"
          - "  102 = proxmox-backup-server (PBS itself)"
          - "  600 = desktop-tmp (temporary desktop)"
          - ""
          - "Next steps:"
          - "  1. Verify in Proxmox UI: Datacenter > Backup"
          - "  2. Test backup: Run backup job manually"
          - "  3. Monitor PBS: https://10.100.1.102:8007"
      tags: [verify, configure]

    # =========================================================================
    # Manual Trigger (Optional)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Trigger daily backup now (manual)
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: pvesh create /cluster/backup-info/not-backed-up --output-format=json
      register: trigger_result
      when: trigger_now is defined and trigger_now | bool
      tags: [never, trigger]

    - name: Display trigger result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ trigger_result.stdout | from_json }}"
      when: trigger_now is defined and trigger_now | bool
      tags: [never, trigger]

        echo "Run this command directly on your Proxmox host:"

        echo ""
        echo "Default settings: 2 cores, 2GB RAM, 10GB disk, Port 8007"

    cmds:

---
# =============================================================================
# Backup All LXC Containers
# =============================================================================
# Performs vzdump backup of all containers to PBS/local storage.
# Replaces: scripts/backup/backup-all.sh
#
# Usage:
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml -e backup_storage=pbs
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml --tags pre-backup
# =============================================================================

- name: Backup all LXC containers
  hosts: proxmox
  gather_facts: no

  vars:
    backup_storage: "{{ backup_storage | default('backup-tank') }}"
    backup_mode: "{{ backup_mode | default('snapshot') }}"
    backup_compress: "{{ backup_compress | default('zstd') }}"
    pre_backup_hook: "/var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh"

    # List of containers to backup (from inventory)
    container_ids: "{{ groups['backup_containers'] | map('extract', hostvars, 'container_id') | list }}"

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Pre-Backup Hook (Optional)
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check if pre-backup hook exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ pre_backup_hook }}"
      register: hook_stat
      tags: [pre-backup]

    - name: Display hook status
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Pre-backup hook {{ 'found' if hook_stat.stat.exists else 'not found' }} at {{ pre_backup_hook }}"
      tags: [pre-backup]

    # =========================================================================
    # Backup All Containers
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Display backup configuration
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Storage: {{ backup_storage }}"
          - "Mode: {{ backup_mode }}"
          - "Compression: {{ backup_compress }}"
          - "Containers: {{ container_ids | join(', ') }}"
      tags: [backup]

    - name: Run vzdump backup for all containers
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          vzdump {{ container_ids | join(' ') }}
          --storage {{ backup_storage }}
          --mode {{ backup_mode }}
          --compress {{ backup_compress }}
          {% if hook_stat.stat.exists %}--script {{ pre_backup_hook }}{% endif %}
      register: backup_result
      changed_when: true
      tags: [backup]

    - name: Display backup result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ backup_result.stdout_lines }}"
      tags: [backup]

    # =========================================================================
    # Backup Summary
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Check backup files
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          if [ "{{ backup_storage }}" = "backup-tank" ]; then
            ls -lh /tank/backup/dump/ | tail -15
          else
            ls -lh /var/lib/vz/dump/ | tail -15
          fi
      register: backup_files
      changed_when: false
      tags: [backup, summary]

    - name: Display recent backups
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ backup_files.stdout_lines }}"
      tags: [backup, summary]

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# Backup Freshness Monitor
# =============================================================================
# Checks that backups are not stale and sends alerts via ntfy if issues found.
# Run via cron on Proxmox: 0 6 * * * /var/lib/vz/snippets/backup-monitor.sh
#
# Exit codes:
#   0 - All backups OK
#   1 - Alert sent (stale or missing backups)
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

BACKUP_DIR="/tank/backups/vzdump/dump"
DB_DUMP_DIR="/tank/backups/database-dumps"
NTFY_URL="${NTFY_URL:-http://10.100.5.100:8093/homelab-alerts}"
LOGFILE="/var/log/backup-monitor.log"

# Thresholds in hours
DAILY_THRESHOLD=36    # Alert if daily backups > 36 hours old
WEEKLY_THRESHOLD=192  # Alert if weekly backups > 8 days old

log() {
    echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') $*" >> "$LOGFILE"
}

send_alert() {
    local priority="$1"
    local title="$2"
    local message="$3"
    local tags="$4"

    log "ALERT [$priority]: $title - $message"

    curl -s -o /dev/null \
        -H "Title: $title" \
        -H "Priority: $priority" \
        -H "Tags: $tags" \
        -d "$message" \
        "$NTFY_URL" || log "Failed to send ntfy alert"
}

# Check age of most recent backup file matching pattern
check_backup_age() {
    local pattern="$1"
    local name="$2"
    local threshold_hours="$3"
    local dir="${4:-$BACKUP_DIR}"

    local newest
    newest=$(find "$dir" -name "$pattern" -type f -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -1 | cut -d' ' -f2-)

    if [[ -z "$newest" ]]; then
        send_alert "urgent" "Backup Missing: $name" "No backups found matching $pattern" "warning,backup"
        return 1
    fi

    local age_seconds
    age_seconds=$(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y "$newest") ))
    local age_hours=$(( age_seconds / 3600 ))

    if [[ $age_hours -gt $threshold_hours ]]; then
        local age_days=$(( age_hours / 24 ))
        send_alert "high" "Stale Backup: $name" "Last backup is ${age_days}d ${age_hours}h old (threshold: ${threshold_hours}h). File: $(basename "$newest")" "warning,backup,clock"
        return 1
    fi

    log "OK: $name - newest backup is ${age_hours}h old ($(basename "$newest"))"
    return 0
}

# =============================================================================
# Main
# =============================================================================

log "Starting backup freshness check"
ALERT_COUNT=0

# Daily backups (should be < 36 hours old)
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-304-*.tar.zst" "Immich (304)" $DAILY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))

check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-502-*.tar.zst" "n8n (502)" $DAILY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))

check_backup_age "openwebui-*.db" "OpenWebUI DB" $DAILY_THRESHOLD "$DB_DUMP_DIR" || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "n8n-*.db" "n8n DB" $DAILY_THRESHOLD "$DB_DUMP_DIR" || ((ALERT_COUNT++))

# Weekly backups (should be < 8 days old)
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-100-*.tar.zst" "Portainer (100)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-101-*.tar.zst" "Network Services (101)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-200-*.tar.zst" "Traefik (200)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-201-*.tar.zst" "Dashboards (201)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-202-*.tar.zst" "Authelia (202)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-401-*.tar.zst" "Jellyfin (401)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-402-*.tar.zst" "Media Management (402)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-500-*.tar.zst" "Monitoring (500)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))

log "Backup check completed: $ALERT_COUNT issues found"

if [[ $ALERT_COUNT -gt 0 ]]; then
    exit 1
fi
exit 0

# Proxmox Vzdump Pre-Backup Hook Script
# =============================================================================
# Called by vzdump before/after backing up each container.
# Performs database dumps for containers that need consistent backups.
#
# Arguments passed by vzdump:
#   $1 - phase (job-start, job-end, job-abort, backup-start, backup-end, backup-abort)
#   $2 - mode (stop, suspend, snapshot)
#   $3 - vmid (container/VM ID)
#
# To add a new container with pre-backup tasks:
#   1. Add a case in the backup-start section below
#   2. Run: task backup:sync:hook
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

PHASE="$1"
MODE="${2:-}"
VMID="${3:-}"

LOGFILE="/var/log/vzdump-hooks.log"
DB_DUMP_DIR="/tank/backups/database-dumps"

log() {
    echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') [$PHASE] VMID=$VMID: $*" >> "$LOGFILE"
}

# =============================================================================
# Database Backup Functions
# =============================================================================

# Immich PostgreSQL (Container ID: 304)
backup_immich_postgres() {
    log "Dumping Immich PostgreSQL..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/immich-postgres-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql.gz"

    if pct exec 304 -- docker exec immich_postgres \
        pg_dump -U immich -d immich --clean --if-exists 2>/dev/null \
        | gzip > "$DUMP_FILE"; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "Database dump completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: Database dump failed"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 7 days)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "immich-postgres-*.sql.gz" -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# OpenWebUI SQLite (Container ID: 501)
backup_openwebui_sqlite() {
    log "Creating OpenWebUI SQLite backup..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/openwebui-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).db"

    # Copy the SQLite database file directly from the LXC container
    # The volume mount puts webui.db at /config/openwebui/webui.db on the LXC host
    if pct pull 501 /config/openwebui/webui.db "$DUMP_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "SQLite backup completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: SQLite backup failed"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 7 days)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "openwebui-*.db" -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# n8n SQLite (Container ID: 502)
backup_n8n_sqlite() {
    log "Creating n8n SQLite backup..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/n8n-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).db"

    # Copy the SQLite database file directly from the LXC container
    # n8n stores its database at /config/n8n/database.sqlite
    if pct pull 502 /config/n8n/database.sqlite "$DUMP_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "SQLite backup completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: SQLite backup failed (container may not exist yet)"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 7 days)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "n8n-*.db" -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Jellyfin Jellystat PostgreSQL (Container ID: 401)
backup_jellystat_postgres() {
    log "Dumping Jellystat PostgreSQL..."
    local DUMP_FILE
    DUMP_FILE="$DB_DUMP_DIR/jellystat-postgres-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql.gz"

    # Jellystat uses postgres:15-alpine with database "jellystat" and user "jellystat"
    if pct exec 401 -- docker exec jellystat-db \
        pg_dump -U jellystat -d jellystat --clean --if-exists 2>/dev/null \
        | gzip > "$DUMP_FILE"; then
        local SIZE
        SIZE=$(du -h "$DUMP_FILE" | cut -f1)
        log "Database dump completed: $DUMP_FILE ($SIZE)"
    else
        log "WARNING: Jellystat database dump failed"
        return 1
    fi

    # Cleanup old dumps (keep 4 weeks for weekly backups)
    find "$DB_DUMP_DIR" -name "jellystat-postgres-*.sql.gz" -mtime +28 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
}

# =============================================================================
# Main Logic
# =============================================================================

case "$PHASE" in
    job-start)
        mkdir -p "$DB_DUMP_DIR"
        log "Backup job starting"
        ;;

    backup-start)
        log "Backup starting (mode: $MODE)"

        # Container-specific pre-backup tasks
        case "$VMID" in
            304)
                # Immich - dump PostgreSQL before backup
                backup_immich_postgres || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            401)
                # Jellyfin - dump Jellystat PostgreSQL before backup
                backup_jellystat_postgres || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            501)
                # OpenWebUI - backup SQLite database
                backup_openwebui_sqlite || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            502)
                # n8n - backup SQLite database
                backup_n8n_sqlite || log "Continuing despite dump failure"
                ;;
            *)
                # No pre-backup tasks for this container
                ;;
        esac
        ;;

    backup-end)
        log "Backup completed"
        ;;

    backup-abort)
        log "WARNING: Backup aborted"
        ;;

    job-end)
        log "Backup job completed"
        ;;

    job-abort)
        log "ERROR: Backup job aborted"
        ;;

    *)
        log "Unknown phase: $PHASE"
        ;;
esac

exit 0

# Homelab Infrastructure

OpenTofu-managed homelab running on Proxmox with LXC containers.

## Architecture

- **Hardware**: GMKTec evo-x1 (AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX370, 32GB RAM, 1TB NVMe)
- **Host OS**: Proxmox 9.0.3
- **Storage**: 5x 22TB HDD NAS via USB3.0 enclosure
- **IaC**: OpenTofu with per-app state files
- **Secrets**: 1Password CLI integration

## Services

| App | Container ID | Description |
|-----|--------------|-------------|
| Traefik | 200 | Reverse proxy with Let's Encrypt |
| Portainer | 100 | Container management UI |
| Dashboards | 201 | Homepage + Dashy |
| Immich | 304 | Photo management with ML |
| OpenWebUI | 501 | AI chat interface |
| Network Services | 101 | AdGuard Home DNS |
| Monitoring | 500 | Prometheus + Grafana + Alerting |

## Network Domains

- `*.rambtech.dev` - Public access via Cloudflare tunnel
- `*.homelab.rambtech.dev` - Internal network
- `*.tailnet.rambtech.dev` - Tailscale VPN

## Quick Start

```bash
# Setup state encryption (one-time)
task tofu:encryption:setup

# Initialize an app
task tofu:init APP=dashboards

# Plan and apply
task tofu:plan APP=dashboards
task tofu:apply APP=dashboards

# SSH to deployed LXC
task tofu:ssh APP=dashboards

# Sync compose changes
task tofu:sync:compose APP=dashboards
```

## Project Structure

```text
tofu/
├── apps/                # Per-app configs (each has own state)
│   ├── dashboards/      # Homepage + Dashy (ID: 201)
│   ├── immich/          # Photo management (ID: 304)
│   ├── monitoring/      # Prometheus + Grafana + Alerting (ID: 500)
│   ├── network-services/# AdGuard + DNS (ID: 101)
│   ├── openwebui/       # AI chat (ID: 501)
│   ├── portainer/       # Container UI (ID: 100)
│   └── traefik/         # Reverse proxy (ID: 200)
├── configs/             # Generated configs
│   └── traefik/dynamic/ # Traefik route files
├── modules/             # Reusable modules
│   ├── docker-host/     # LXC + Docker + compose
│   ├── lxc-base/        # Base LXC container
│   ├── file-sync/       # Rsync file transfers
│   └── proxmox-notes/   # LXC description
└── shared.tf            # Common variables (symlinked to apps)
```

## Per-App State

Each app has independent state, allowing:

- Deploy/destroy apps independently
- Smaller state files, faster operations
- Isolated blast radius

## State Encryption

State files are encrypted and committed to git:

- **Method**: AES-GCM with PBKDF2 key derivation
- **Passphrase**: Stored in 1Password (`op://homelab/opentofu/password`)
- **Auto-retrieval**: Taskfile fetches from 1Password automatically

## 1Password Integration

Secrets are managed directly via the 1Password OpenTofu provider (`1password/onepassword`), eliminating the need for environment variables or `.env` files.

### Secret Flow

```text
┌─────────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐     ┌─────────────────┐
│  1Password CLI  │────▶│ OpenTofu Provider│────▶│   local.op.*    │
│  (biometric)    │     │ (1password/...)  │     │   secrets map   │
└─────────────────┘     └──────────────────┘     └─────────────────┘
```

### Key Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `tofu/onepassword.tf` | Data sources for 1Password items + `local.op` helper |
| `tofu/versions.tf` | Provider configs using `local.op.*` for auth |
| `tofu/shared.tf` | Only `state_encryption_passphrase` var (required for encryption) |

### How It Works

1. **Provider authenticates via 1Password CLI** with biometric unlock
2. **Data sources fetch items** from the `homelab` vault at plan/apply time
3. **Helper locals flatten nested fields** into easy-to-access `local.op.*` map
4. **Providers use secrets directly** - no environment variables needed

### Accessing Secrets in OpenTofu

```hcl
# In any .tf file (with onepassword.tf symlinked):
provider "proxmox" {
  api_token = local.op.proxmox_api_token  # Fetched from 1Password
}

# Pass to Docker Compose via env_vars:
module "docker_host" {
  env_vars = {
    API_KEY = local.op.some_api_key
  }
}
```

### Available Secrets (`local.op.*`)

| Secret | Source Item | Field |
|--------|-------------|-------|
| `proxmox_api_token` | opentofu | proxmox_api_token (section field) |
| `cloudflare_api_token` | Cloudflare | ddns_api_token (section field) |
| `cloudflare_tunnel_token` | Cloudflare | tunnel_token (section field) |
| `grafana_admin_password` | grafana | password (main field) |
| `discord_webhook_url` | discord-alertmanager-webhook | credential |

### Adding a New Secret

1. **Create/update 1Password item** in the `homelab` vault

2. **Add data source** to `tofu/onepassword.tf`:

   ```hcl
   data "onepassword_item" "myservice" {
     vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
     title = "myservice"
   }
   ```

3. **Add to `local.op` map**:

   ```hcl
   locals {
     op = {
       # For main password field:
       myservice_password = data.onepassword_item.myservice.password

       # For custom fields in sections (flatten first):
       myservice_api_key = lookup(local._myservice_fields, "api_key", "")
     }
   }
   ```

4. **Use in modules**: `local.op.myservice_password`

### 1Password Field Structure

The provider returns a nested structure for custom fields:

```hcl
# Item structure:
# - password: main password field
# - credential: credential field (for API keys)
# - section[]: array of sections
#   - field[]: array of fields in section
#     - label: field name
#     - value: field value

# Flatten section fields for easy access:
locals {
  _item_fields = merge([
    for s in data.onepassword_item.myitem.section : {
      for f in s.field : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

### Why State Encryption Uses TF_VAR

State encryption runs **before** providers initialize, so it cannot use the 1Password provider. The passphrase must be provided via `TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase`:

```yaml

env:
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password"

|------------|--------|
| `opentofu` | password (encryption), proxmox_api_token (section) |
| `Cloudflare` | tunnel_token, ddns_api_token, Api token - traefik (sections) |
| `grafana` | password |
| `discord-alertmanager-webhook` | credential |

- 1Password CLI v2.23.0+ (`brew install 1password-cli`)
- Signed in account (`op signin`)
- Biometric unlock enabled (recommended)
- Ansible Navigator (`uv tool install ansible-navigator`) - for Ansible-based deployment and LXC configuration

### docker-host

Creates LXC, installs Docker, deploys compose files.

```hcl
module "myapp" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-host"

  memory = 2048

  compose_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"
  tags        = ["opentofu", "myapp"]
}

Generates Traefik dynamic config and syncs to Traefik LXC.

# =============================================================================
# Backup Specific LXC Container(s)
# =============================================================================
# Performs vzdump backup of specific containers by name or ID.
# Replaces: scripts/backup/backup-app.sh
#
# Usage:
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich,jellyfin
#   ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e container_id=304
# =============================================================================

- name: Backup specific LXC container(s)
  hosts: proxmox
  gather_facts: no

  vars:
    backup_storage: "{{ backup_storage | default('backup-tank') }}"
    backup_mode: "{{ backup_mode | default('snapshot') }}"
    backup_compress: "{{ backup_compress | default('zstd') }}"
    pre_backup_hook: "/var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh"

  tasks:
    # =========================================================================
    # Validate Input
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Fail if no target specified
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: "Must specify either 'target' (hostname) or 'container_id'"
      when: target is not defined and container_id is not defined

    # =========================================================================
    # Resolve Container IDs from Hostnames
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Parse target hostnames
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        target_hosts: "{{ target.split(',') | map('trim') | list }}"
      when: target is defined

    - name: Get container IDs from hostnames
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        target_container_ids: "{{ target_hosts | map('extract', hostvars, 'container_id') | list }}"
      when: target is defined

    - name: Use provided container ID
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        target_container_ids: ["{{ container_id }}"]
      when: container_id is defined and target is not defined

    # =========================================================================
    # Backup Containers
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Display backup configuration
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Storage: {{ backup_storage }}"
          - "Mode: {{ backup_mode }}"
          - "Compression: {{ backup_compress }}"
          - "Container IDs: {{ target_container_ids | join(', ') }}"

    - name: Check if pre-backup hook exists
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ pre_backup_hook }}"
      register: hook_stat

    - name: Run vzdump backup
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: >
          vzdump {{ target_container_ids | join(' ') }}
          --storage {{ backup_storage }}
          --mode {{ backup_mode }}
          --compress {{ backup_compress }}
          {% if hook_stat.stat.exists %}--script {{ pre_backup_hook }}{% endif %}
      register: backup_result
      changed_when: true

    - name: Display backup result
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ backup_result.stdout_lines }}"

    # =========================================================================
    # Verify Backup Files
    # =========================================================================
    - name: Find backup files for containers
      ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: |
          if [ "{{ backup_storage }}" = "backup-tank" ]; then
            ls -lhtr /tank/backup/dump/ | grep -E "{{ target_container_ids | join('|') }}" | tail -{{ target_container_ids | length }}
          else
            ls -lhtr /var/lib/vz/dump/ | grep -E "{{ target_container_ids | join('|') }}" | tail -{{ target_container_ids | length }}
          fi
      register: backup_files
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display backup files
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ backup_files.stdout_lines }}"

# Ansible Automation for Homelab

Operational automation playbooks for backup, monitoring, and day-2 operations.

## 📁 Directory Structure

```
ansible/
├── ansible.cfg              # Ansible configuration
├── inventory/
│   └── hosts.yml           # Static inventory (all LXCs + Proxmox)
├── playbooks/              # Standalone playbooks
│   ├── backup-all.yml      # Backup all containers
│   ├── backup-lxc.yml      # Backup specific containers
│   └── backup-immich-db.yml # Backup Immich database
├── roles/                  # Reusable roles (future)
├── group_vars/            # Group-specific variables
└── host_vars/             # Host-specific variables
```

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Prerequisites

```bash
# Install ansible-navigator (already installed via uv)
uv tool install ansible-navigator

# Verify SSH access
ssh root@homelab
```

### Running Playbooks

All commands run from the `ansible/` directory:

```bash
cd ansible

# Backup all containers
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml

# Backup specific containers
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich,jellyfin
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e container_id=304

# Backup Immich database
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml
```

## 📋 Available Playbooks

### Backup Operations

#### `backup-all.yml`
Backup all LXC containers using vzdump.

**Options:**
- `backup_storage`: Storage target (default: `backup-tank`)
- `backup_mode`: Backup mode (default: `snapshot`)
- `backup_compress`: Compression (default: `zstd`)

**Examples:**
```bash
# Standard backup to backup-tank
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml

# Backup to PBS
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml -e backup_storage=pbs

# Run only pre-backup hooks
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-all.yml --tags pre-backup
```

**Replaces:** `scripts/backup/backup-all.sh`

---

#### `backup-lxc.yml`
Backup specific containers by hostname or container ID.

**Required:**
- `target`: Comma-separated hostnames (e.g., `immich,jellyfin`)
- OR `container_id`: Single container ID

**Examples:**
```bash
# Backup by hostname
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich

# Backup multiple containers
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e target=immich,jellyfin,traefik

# Backup by container ID
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-lxc.yml -e container_id=304
```

**Replaces:** `scripts/backup/backup-app.sh`

---

#### `backup-immich-db.yml`
Create PostgreSQL database dump for Immich.

**Options:**
- `backup_dir`: Backup directory (default: `/photos/immich-backups`)
- `retention_days`: Days to keep old backups (default: `7`)

**Examples:**
```bash
# Standard database backup
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml

# Custom backup location
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml -e backup_dir=/custom/path

# Longer retention
ansible-playbook playbooks/backup-immich-db.yml -e retention_days=30
```

**Replaces:** `scripts/backup/immich-db.sh`

---

## 🎯 Inventory

The inventory is defined in [inventory/hosts.yml](inventory/hosts.yml) and mirrors the IP registry from OpenTofu ([tofu/apps/traefik/ip-registry.tf](../tofu/apps/traefik/ip-registry.tf)).

### Groups

- `proxmox`: Proxmox VE host
- `lxc`: All LXC containers
  - `core`: Portainer, network-services, PBS
  - `dashboards`: Traefik, Homepage, Authelia
  - `photos`: Immich, immich-importer
  - `media`: Jellyfin, media-management
  - `monitoring`: Monitoring, OpenWebUI, n8n, Obsidian, Documents
- `backup_containers`: Containers to include in backups
- `docker_containers`: Containers running Docker Compose

### Viewing Inventory

```bash
# List all hosts
ansible-inventory --list

# List specific group
ansible-inventory --graph backup_containers

# Show host details
ansible-inventory --host immich
```

## 🔧 Testing Connectivity

```bash
# Ping all hosts
ansible all -m ping

# Ping specific group
ansible backup_containers -m ping

# Run command on all LXCs
ansible lxc -a "uptime"
```

## 📝 Configuration

The [ansible.cfg](ansible.cfg) file configures:
- Inventory location
- SSH settings (uses `~/.ssh/homelab_ed25519`)
- Output formatting (YAML)
- Performance tuning (10 forks, fact caching)
- Logging (`/tmp/ansible.log`)

## 🆚 Comparison: Bash vs Ansible

### Before (Bash)
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/backup/backup-all.sh

source "$SCRIPT_DIR/containers.sh"
ssh root@homelab "vzdump $ALL_BACKUP_CONTAINERS --storage backup-tank --mode snapshot --compress zstd"
```

**Issues:**
- No error handling
- Manual container list management
- No idempotency
- Limited logging

### After (Ansible)
```yaml
# playbooks/backup-all.yml

- name: Backup all LXC containers
  hosts: proxmox
  tasks:
    - name: Run vzdump backup
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: vzdump {{ container_ids | join(' ') }} ...
      register: backup_result
```

**Benefits:**
- ✅ Automatic inventory from hosts.yml
- ✅ Error handling built-in
- ✅ Idempotent operations
- ✅ Structured logging
- ✅ Dry-run support (`--check`)
- ✅ Tags for selective execution

---

### Temporary Infrastructure

#### `desktop-lxc.yml`
Create/destroy temporary desktop LXC for Google Takeout downloads.

**Tags:**
- `create`: Create desktop LXC with XFCE + VNC + Chrome
- `destroy`: Destroy desktop LXC

**Examples:**
```bash
# Create desktop
ansible-playbook playbooks/desktop-lxc.yml --tags create

# Destroy desktop
ansible-playbook playbooks/desktop-lxc.yml --tags destroy
```

**Features:**
- Ubuntu 24.04 LXC with XFCE desktop
- TigerVNC server on port 5901
- Google Chrome pre-installed
- NAS mount at /downloads → /tank/photo-import
- Random VNC password generated on creation

**Replaces:** `scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh`, `scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh`

---

### PBS Management

#### `pbs-configure-jobs.yml`

Configure Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) backup jobs.

**Tags:**

- `configure`: Create/update backup jobs in Proxmox
- `verify`: Verify existing backup job configuration

**Examples:**

```bash
# Configure PBS backup jobs
ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml --tags configure

# Verify current configuration
ansible-playbook playbooks/pbs-configure-jobs.yml --tags verify
```

**Features:**

- Configures two backup schedules:
  - **Daily** (2 AM): User data containers (immich, openwebui, n8n, obsidian-sync, documents)
  - **Weekly** (Sunday 3 AM): Infrastructure containers (traefik, portainer, authelia, etc.)
- Uses PBS storage (`pbs-homelab`) with proper retention policies
- Automatically includes pre-backup hooks if available
- Excludes PBS container (102) and temporary containers (600)

**Backup Strategy:**

- Daily backups: Keep 7 days
- Weekly backups: Keep 4 weeks
- All backups use snapshot mode with zstd compression

---

## 🔮 Future Playbooks

Planned additions:
- `cloud-sync.yml` - Sync backups to cloud storage (B2)
- `container-update.yml` - Update Docker images across containers
- `monitoring-check.yml` - Health checks for all services
- `certificate-renew.yml` - Force certificate renewal
- `pbs-verify.yml` - Trigger PBS verification jobs
- `pbs-status.yml` - Check PBS backup health

## 📚 Resources

- [Ansible Documentation](https://docs.ansible.com/)
- [ansible-navigator](https://ansible.readthedocs.io/projects/navigator/)
- [Proxmox VE Ansible Modules](https://docs.ansible.com/ansible/latest/collections/community/general/proxmox_module.html)

# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Network Architecture:
#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
#
# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      portainer        = "10.100.1.100"  # LXC 100 - Container management
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
    }

    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    dashboards = {
      traefik    = "10.100.2.200"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
      dashboards = "10.100.2.201"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      authelia   = "10.100.2.202"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth
    }

    # Media - Photos (LXC 300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
    photos = {
      immich_importer = "10.100.3.103"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
      immich          = "10.100.3.104"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
    }

    # Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
    media = {
      jellyfin         = "10.100.4.101"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "10.100.4.102"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack
    }

    # Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
    monitoring = {
      monitoring    = "10.100.5.100"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui     = "10.100.5.101"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n           = "10.100.5.102"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
      obsidian_sync = "10.100.5.103"  # LXC 503 - Obsidian LiveSync (CouchDB)
      documents     = "10.100.5.104"  # LXC 504 - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LAN IPs for Dual-NIC Services (192.168.1.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # These services need direct LAN access for compatibility with home devices

  lan_ips = {
    traefik          = "192.168.1.235"  # LXC 200 - LAN clients access services
    network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - DNS for LAN devices
    jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - DLNA/casting
    immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Mobile app sync
    immich_importer  = "192.168.1.223"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)
    100 = local.ip_registry.core.portainer
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs

    # Dashboards & Auth (200-249)
    200 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards
    202 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia

    # Photos (300-349)
    303 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
    503 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync
    504 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.dashboards,
      local.ip_registry.photos,
      local.ip_registry.media,
      local.ip_registry.monitoring,
    ) : name => "${ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  }

  lan_ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in local.lan_ips : name => "${ip}${local.network.lan_netmask}"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convenience: Traefik IP for route modules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Used by traefik-route modules to sync config to Traefik LXC via SSH
  # Must use LAN IP since container network isn't routable from local machine
  traefik_ip = local.lan_ips.traefik

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flatten all allocated IPs for validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  _all_container_ips = concat(
    values(local.ip_registry.core),
    values(local.ip_registry.dashboards),
    values(local.ip_registry.photos),
    values(local.ip_registry.media),
    values(local.ip_registry.monitoring),
  )

  _all_lan_ips = values(local.lan_ips)
}

# =============================================================================
# Outputs for CLI Usage
# =============================================================================

output "container_ips" {
  description = "All container IPs (10.100.x.x)"
  value       = local._all_container_ips
}

output "lan_ips" {
  description = "LAN IPs for dual-NIC services (192.168.1.x)"
  value       = local.lan_ips
}

output "ip_registry" {
  description = "Full IP registry organized by category"
  value       = local.ip_registry
}

output "network" {
  description = "Network configuration"
  value       = local.network
}

# Homelab Alert Rules
# Only includes alerts for metrics we actually collect

groups:
  - name: services
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      # Prometheus target down
      - alert: TargetDown
        expr: up == 0
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: "Target {{ $labels.instance }} is down"
          description: "Prometheus cannot reach {{ $labels.job }} target {{ $labels.instance }}"

      # Traefik high error rate
      - alert: TraefikHighErrorRate
        expr: sum(rate(traefik_entrypoint_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(traefik_entrypoint_requests_total[5m])) > 0.05
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "High error rate on Traefik"
          description: "More than 5% of requests are returning 5xx errors"

      # Traefik backend down
      - alert: TraefikBackendDown
        expr: traefik_service_server_up == 0
        for: 2m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: "Traefik backend {{ $labels.service }} is down"
          description: "Backend service {{ $labels.service }} is not responding"

  - name: proxmox
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      # Proxmox host high CPU
      - alert: ProxmoxHighCPU
        expr: proxmox_node_cpustat_cpu_percent > 80
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "High CPU on Proxmox node"
          description: "Proxmox node CPU usage above 80% for 10 minutes (current: {{ $value | printf \"%.1f\" }}%)"

      # Proxmox host memory high
      - alert: ProxmoxHighMemory
        expr: (proxmox_node_memory_memused_bytes / proxmox_node_memory_memtotal_bytes) * 100 > 85
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "High memory on Proxmox node"
          description: "Proxmox node memory usage above 85% for 10 minutes"

      # Proxmox storage low
      - alert: ProxmoxStorageLow
        expr: (proxmox_storage_used_bytes / proxmox_storage_total_bytes) * 100 > 85
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "Low storage on {{ $labels.storage }}"
          description: "Proxmox storage {{ $labels.storage }} is above 85% used"

      # Proxmox storage critical
      - alert: ProxmoxStorageCritical
        expr: (proxmox_storage_used_bytes / proxmox_storage_total_bytes) * 100 > 95
        for: 2m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: "Critical storage on {{ $labels.storage }}"
          description: "Proxmox storage {{ $labels.storage }} is above 95% used"

      # LXC/VM down (no metrics for 5 minutes)
      - alert: ProxmoxVMDown
        expr: changes(proxmox_vm_uptime_seconds[5m]) == 0 and proxmox_vm_uptime_seconds > 0
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "VM/LXC {{ $labels.name }} may be unresponsive"
          description: "No uptime changes detected for VM/LXC {{ $labels.vmid }} ({{ $labels.name }})"

  - name: monitoring
    interval: 1m
    rules:
      # Prometheus TSDB high cardinality
      - alert: PrometheusTSDBHighCardinality
        expr: prometheus_tsdb_head_series > 100000
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "Prometheus high time series count"
          description: "Prometheus has more than 100k active time series (current: {{ $value }})"
